summary.text: Allison Hepler, a Democrat, represents House District 49 (Arrowsic, Georgetown, Phippsburg, West Bath and Woolwich, Sagadahoc County) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Woolwich. The House profile lists service as chair of the Marine Resources Committee and membership on the Agriculture, Conservation and Forestry Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 129th, 130th, 131st and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile gives retired history professor as the occupation and a Ph.D. in history (1996).
Listed affiliations include Maine's First Ship, the Woolwich Historical Society, the Woolwich Select Board and the Patten Free Library.
It lists Hepler marital status as married.
